# TRUYN

> TRUYN is an open-source, trust-aware intelligence network for AI agents, machines and autonomous systems.

## Canonical URLs
- Website: https://truyn.org/
- Source: https://github.com/inn-media/truyn
- Whitepaper: https://github.com/inn-media/truyn/blob/main/WHITEPAPER.md
- Machine facts: https://truyn.org/AGENTS
- Machine FAQ: https://truyn.org/faq.json
- Full LLM context: https://truyn.org/llms-full.txt

## Ownership and maintenance
TRUYN is developed and maintained by InnMedia and Innovation Media Services Inc.

## InnMedia ecosystem
- InnMedia Group — https://innmedia.group/ — infrastructure for the AI information economy.
- InnMedia OS — https://innmediaservices.com/ — enterprise AI content operating system.

- TRUYN — https://truyn.org/ — distributed open intelligence network and machine connectivity layer.

## Core concepts
TRUYN provides cryptographic identity, capability discovery, authorization-aware routing, signed machine requests and results, provenance, trustability primitives, BYOK provider boundaries, MCP integration and agent-to-agent networking over the existing Internet.
